name: drawio-mcp-app
description:
Create diagrams in Claude and see them rendered instantly as live, interactive draw.io diagrams — zoom, pan, toggle layers, and go fullscreen right in the conversation, then open any diagram in the full draw.io editor with one click to keep editing. No account or sign-up required.

Handles flowcharts, cloud and software architecture, ER diagrams, network topologies, UML, BPMN, org charts, mockups, and more. Diagrams can be generated from Mermaid or native draw.io XML, with automatic graph layout and obstacle-avoiding connector routing for clean, professional results.

Built-in shape search covers more than 10,000 shapes from the full draw.io library — AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Kubernetes, Cisco, electrical, P&ID, and many more — plus brand logos and icons, so technical diagrams use real, recognizable symbols.

draw.io is one of the most widely used diagramming tools, trusted by millions of users.

tool.name: search_shapes
tool.title: Search Shapes
tool.description: Search the draw.io shape library by keywords. Returns matching shapes with their exact style strings, dimensions, and titles. Covers ~10,000 built-in stencils (cloud architecture, network topology, P&ID, electrical, Cisco, Kubernetes, BPMN) and, when those are sparse, supplements results with the draw.io icon service (brand/product logos and general-purpose concept icons, e.g. 'react', 'slack', 'shopping cart', 'solar panel'). Use ONLY for diagrams that need industry-specific, branded, or pictorial icons. Do NOT use for standard diagram types like flowcharts, UML, ERD, org charts, or mind maps — these use basic geometric shapes (rectangles, diamonds, circles, cylinders) that are already covered in the XML reference. Also skip if the user asks to use basic/simple shapes or says not to search. The style string from the results can be used directly in mxCell style attributes.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 10, max: 50)

style.description: mxCell style string, usable verbatim in a style attribute

shapes.description: Matching shapes, best match first — empty when nothing matched the query.

_published_faq.name: How do I add drawio-mcp-app to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add drawio-mcp-app to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.draw.io/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is drawio-mcp-app MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 6, 2026, drawio-mcp-app scores 90/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: How clear is drawio-mcp-app's MCP tool documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 6, 2026, drawio-mcp-app scores 48/100 in Manufact's review of tool titles, descriptions, input and output schemas, and behavior annotations. The review covers 2 of 2 discovered tools. The quality score measures documentation clarity; runtime behavior and marketplace readiness require separate checks.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the drawio-mcp-app MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: drawio-mcp-app provides these MCP tools: create_diagram and search_shapes.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to drawio-mcp-app?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to drawio-mcp-app in design-creative on the Manufact MCP catalog include Motion, MotionVid, Sleek, Streamloop MCP, and Image Generation.
drawio-mcp-app does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
drawio-mcp-app is developed by draw.io AG. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
